# SHIFT Beat

> Offline DJ transition analysis for macOS 15+, on Intel and Apple Silicon.

- [Home](https://shift-beat.com/): Features, pricing and release availability.
- [Terms](https://shift-beat.com/terms.html): Terms of Service.

Analyzes local MP3, AIFF and WAV tracks for entry and exit points. Offers Build (displayed as DROP BEAT), Release Tension and Maintain, with up to 25 ranked matches per mode within ±8 BPM. Users build playlists by choosing the first track and each next saved transition. Playlist Order and Hot Cues are separate exports for rekordbox, Serato DJ 4+ and Soundblast DJ. Playlist files reference existing audio without copying it. Supports saved libraries, handoff previews and CSV/JSON reports. Rankings are suggestions, not guarantees.

Subscription: EUR 50 per month. Support: support@shift-beat.com.
